description: Override the workspace camera. Latest set_camera op wins during replay. Two modes: `fitBounds` with a [w,s,e,n] bbox (plus optional padding/animateMs), or `flyTo` with [lng,lat] center + zoom (plus optional pitch/bearing/animateMs). Covers requests like "zoom to Japan", "center on Paris at z=10", or framing a filtered layer. Equivalent to the camera move mutate_map would emit, but skips the NL roundtrip.

animateMs.description: Animation duration in ms. 0 = instant jump.

bounds.description: [west, south, east, north] bbox in WGS84 degrees.

padding.description: Pixel padding around the bbox. Default is the renderer default.

animateMs.description: Animation duration in ms. 0 = instant jump.

rationale.description: Optional short label (≤300 chars) for the map edit history, e.g. "add wildfire layer". Omit it to send nothing beyond the tool arguments.

name: set_camera
title: Set the map camera (direct)
